title: Frame-accurate review, annotation, edit decisions, and approval
accessibility: Space, arrow, and submission shortcuts do not conflict with text entry
Player controls have names, states, and minimum touch targets
Annotation location and timecode are available without color alone
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Review mutations require asset and project authority
Approval cannot target a superseded or ambiguous version
Client-provided actor identity is not trusted
persistence: Submitted point comments preserve timecode and normalized coordinates
Edit decisions and approval state survive reload and session renewal
concurrency: Concurrent comments are not lost or reordered ambiguously
Approval and version creation conflicts resolve deterministically
degradedDependencies: Realtime loss falls back to bounded polling without duplicate comments
Media stream failure preserves authored draft text
AI transcript outage does not disable manual review
rollback: Failed annotation submission leaves a retryable local draft
Approval rollback is an explicit audited action, never an overwrite
